summary: [spec-fidelity] What r1/10 asked is still open at d9ea4138 for six scenarios, so they stay unsigned. brief-check.17 (brief_format.rs:218-246): no comparison of F1/F2 with a 0.30 brief, brief show/status are checked for state and counts only (not keys and roles), and no chore review or ship reads the new brief. brief-check.22 (:390-425): the ship check never runs; status briefs[].reason stands in for it. migrate.22 (:777-840): the Given's review pinned to a chore is never created, so 'the chore review is a new version pinned to the new digest with every other field as before' is unasserted. migrate.25 (:896-964): old_repo has no review, so 'old reviews byte for byte' and the refusal on a changed review version are untested (and a later plain edit, see r2/1). lifecycle.47 (:619-659): no subject ever moves (the draft case asserts only != OLD_BRIEF_FORMAT plus SUBJECT_GATE_VIOLATION), no reopen runs, and the second subject 'other' is another refused case, not the one that moves. dashboard.05: its Then now includes 'a Korean-prose brief reads the same, and a shipped Korean heading is flagged old-format', which report_dashboard_05 (dashboard_briefs.rs:203-237) does not assert; report_dashboard_16 does, so cite both in its evidence or extend the test. Closed in r2: dashboard.16 now loads /api/briefs (dashboard_briefs.rs:272-291).
